# Readout: continue_after_fail_v1

*Generated by `python run.py` from simulated data. Tower Stack is a fictional game.*

**Decision: DO NOT SHIP AS IS: primary metric up, but the retention guardrail is breached.**

## Validity

* Split: 29,958 control, 30,042 continue; sample ratio p = 0.73 (alarm below 0.001).
* Tracking: 360 injected bugs caught out of 360, 0 false alarm on 475,134 clean events; clean events rebuild every player-day exactly.
* Statistics: 5.2 % false positives over 1000 A/A tests, 94.8 % of 95 % intervals contain the true effect.

## Results (14 days)

| Metric | Control | Continue | Lift | 95 % interval |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| **Ad revenue per player (primary, CUPED)** | $0.202 | $0.220 | **+8.8 %** | +7.2 % to +10.4 % |
| **Week-2 retention (guardrail)** | 70.4 % | 68.8 % | **-1.5 pt** | lower bound -2.1 pt, allowed -1.0 pt |
| Total revenue | 0.285 | 0.305 | +6.7 % | -1.9 % to +15.3 % |
| In-app purchases | 0.083 | 0.084 | +2.2 % | -26.4 % to +30.7 % |
| Active days (significant after Holm) | 3.374 | 3.183 | -5.7 % | -6.6 % to -4.8 % |
| Sessions (significant after Holm) | 12.264 | 11.893 | -3.0 % | -4.1 % to -1.9 % |
| Levels completed | 51.544 | 50.936 | -1.2 % | -2.4 % to -0.0 % |

## Reading

* The continue sells ads: +8.8 % ad revenue per player. But the gain fades, from +16 % on day 0 to +4 % over the last four days, while players come back less: active days and sessions drop, and week-2 retention loses 1.5 points, beyond the 1-point margin agreed before the test.
* Total revenue is not significant: in-app purchases make it too noisy to read in two weeks (coefficient of variation 7.3, 171,698 players per arm to detect 5 %).
* Exploratory segments do not show a group where retention holds; they are hypotheses, not a reason to ship.

## Next steps

1. Do not roll out the continue as it is.
2. Test a capped version (one continue every other session) against control, 4 weeks, same guardrail.
3. Keep a 5 % long-term holdout on any version that ships, to measure the effect once the novelty is gone.
